candidates.change_summary: Replace the line that zeroes the reward before the external call with zeroing it after the call, enabling reentrancy to observe different post-call state.
Remove the locking behavior by commenting out setting _locked to true, allowing reentrant calls to proceed and potentially change withdrawReward observable state.
Change the external call to use transfer (which reverts on failure differently) instead of low-level call, altering post-call behavior and revert semantics affecting observable state.
